metadata.title: Stocks Are Facing a Summer Storm. Don’t Bank on Help From Google Earnings, and 5 Other Things to Know Today<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Stocks Are Facing a Summer Storm. Don’t Bank on Help From Google Earnings.
U.S. airstrikes on Iran accelerating, AI agents going rogue, Japan’s yen reaching a new four decade low, and 30-year bond yields testing the highest levels since the global financial crisis.
